title: Finalize VPN Super Pro: admin ownership, dashboard metrics, contact/privacy pages, AdMob config usage, and APK artifact

requirements.text: Make the AdMob configuration saved in the Admin Panel usable by the end-user app (not admin-only): expose a backend query that allows non-admin users to read the current AdMob App ID and rewarded ad unit ID, and update the frontend ad flow to use this saved config with a safe fallback when no config exists.

quotes: Final Build: Integrate the Logo and AdMob IDs I saved in the Admin Panel.
Earning Ready: Ensure all Ad units are properly placed so earnings start as soon as users open the app.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides a non-admin-readable query that returns the saved AdMob config (or null/empty when not set) without trapping for non-admin callers.
Frontend rewarded-ad flow uses the saved AdMob config for all users when available; if not available, it falls back to the values in frontend/src/config/admob.ts without breaking the UI.
Non-admin users do not see authorization/trap errors related to reading AdMob configuration during normal app usage.

requirements.text: Ensure the app logo uploaded/saved in the Admin Panel is consistently used across the app UI (header/app shell) for all users, with a clear fallback icon when no logo exists.

quotes: Final Build: Integrate the Logo and AdMob IDs I saved in the Admin Panel.

acceptanceCriteria: When a logo exists in the backend, the main app header displays it for authenticated and unauthenticated users.
When no logo exists, the app displays the existing fallback icon without layout breakage.

requirements.text: Activate and complete the Admin Dashboard experience to monitor: (a) live users, (b) total installs, and (c) block/unblock any user. Add an installs metric backed by persistent backend data and render it in the admin dashboard alongside existing metrics.

quotes: Admin Dashboard: Activate the dashboard where I can monitor live users, total installs, and block any user if needed.

acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard shows a 'Live Users' metric derived from currently active sessions (time-based).
Backend persists a 'total installs' (or equivalent unique install count) metric and exposes it via an admin-only overview endpoint.
Frontend Admin Panel displays 'Total Installs' as a separate metric from total registered user count (even if they are equal initially, the fields must be distinct and backed by backend data).
Admin can block and unblock users from the Admin Panel, and the blocked status is reflected in the UI for each user row.
A blocked user is prevented from unlocking/using VPN sessions and receives a clear error/state in the VPN panel.

requirements.text: Add a 'Contact Us' page and link it from the app UI; the page must provide a mailto link to Muhammadramadan121555@gmail.com so users can reach support.

quotes: Support & Contact: Ensure the 'Contact Us' page is linked to my email: Muhammadramadan121555@gmail.com so users can reach me.

acceptanceCriteria: A new route/page exists for 'Contact Us' and is accessible from the main app navigation (e.g., footer link).
The Contact Us page displays the support email and includes a working mailto link to Muhammadramadan121555@gmail.com.
All user-facing text on the Contact Us page is in English.

requirements.text: Ensure the Privacy Policy page is complete, professional, and accessible from the app UI (footer or equivalent), and that it uses the configured support email for contact.

quotes: Privacy Policy: Generate a complete Privacy Policy page to ensure the app is professional and safe.

acceptanceCriteria: Privacy Policy page is reachable from the app UI and loads without authentication errors.
Privacy Policy page includes a clear 'Contact Us' section that uses the support email from frontend/src/config/support.ts.
All user-facing text on the Privacy Policy page is in English.

requirements.text: Earning-ready ad placement: ensure that the app’s ad experience is presented immediately when users attempt to unlock VPN access, and that the ad configuration shown/used comes from the saved AdMob IDs when available.

quotes: Earning Ready: Ensure all Ad units are properly placed so earnings start as soon as users open the app.

acceptanceCriteria: From the locked VPN state, the primary CTA reliably opens the ad experience without errors.
The ad experience displays/uses the saved AdMob App ID and rewarded ad unit ID (when configured), otherwise falls back to placeholders.
No admin-only API calls are required for normal (non-admin) users to reach the ad experience flow.

requirements.text: Generate the final Android APK artifact for the current release build of 'VPN Super Pro' and provide a direct download link as build output.

quotes: Generate APK: Now, please provide the direct download link for the final APK file so I can start sharing it on WhatsApp.
Please confirm once the APK is ready for download.

acceptanceCriteria: A release APK is produced for the current app version.
A direct download URL for the APK is returned/recorded as the build artifact link for sharing.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo changes only if state schema must be upgraded.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths; compose existing UI components instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing real native Google Mobile Ads SDK integration inside Android (beyond the app’s existing simulated ad flow) is out of scope for this web-based codebase unless separately provided/required by the build environment.
Integrations with WhatsApp sharing APIs are out of scope; only provide an APK download link suitable for manual sharing.
Adding third-party authentication methods beyond Internet Identity is out of scope.
